lesson_title: LESSON 07: Sharing the Road & Special Circumstances
topic_title: Safely Operating Near Oversize & Overweight Vehicles
prompt: What does a pilot escort vehicle with amber flashing lights and 'OVERSIZE LOAD' banner indicate?

options.text: A private motorcade escorting municipal politicians across county roadways
A geological surveying team mapping subterranean oil pipelines beneath highway
An extra-wide, long, or heavy transport rig follows or leads; prepare for delays/yield
A slow-moving agricultural parade celebrating annual state harvest festivals
